labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Reporter's wrapper piped output; Rich correctly disabled live updates for a non-terminal. Intended behaviour, so a usage question.

body:
The behaviour you saw is intended. Rich only updates a progress bar in place when the console writes to a terminal. When output goes through a pipe such as `tee`, `Console.is_terminal` is false and the bar prints plain lines. See [`is_terminal` in the console docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). Related earlier report: #2326. For usage questions like this, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
